test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two trains, one of length 185 m and the other of length 175 m, are running in opposite directions on parallel tracks, the speeds of the first and second are 80 km/h and 64 km/h respectively. How much time will they take to cross each other?
solution:
Given:

Lengths of two trains = 185 m and 175 m

Speeds of two trains = 80 km/h and 64 km/h

Formulas used:

Relative speed (Opposite direction) = Speed1 + Speed2 

Time = Distance/Relative Speed 

Calculation:

Distance to be covered by two trains = Length of two trains 

⇒ 185 m + 175 m = 360 m 

⇒ 360/ 144× 5/18 

⇒ 360/40 [1 hour = 3600 seconds, 1 km = 1000 m] 

⇒ 9 

∴ The required time taken by the trains to cross each other is 9 seconds.
